# UPD-002: Unattended upgrades ran recently

- **Group:** Updates
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

An enabled setup that has not run for days is a broken setup (timer masked, lock stuck, disk full) that still looks fine in the configuration.

## Verify by hand

```sh
ls -l /var/lib/apt/periodic/ /var/log/unattended-upgrades/
```

## How to fix it

Check the timer (`systemctl list-timers apt-daily-upgrade`) and /var/log/unattended-upgrades/.

Run `stackward explain UPD-002` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
